applicant.name: Prof. Dr. Ingrid Wallner
applicant.organisation: Austrian Institute for Cardiorenal Epidemiology (public health institute)

purpose: We follow patients with heart failure over time to see how kidney function changes after they start new heart failure medicines. This requires each patient's sequence of eGFR values linked to their own prescriptions, which aggregated figures cannot show.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and eGFR values for adults with heart failure who have at least one eGFR value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Cohort = adults with heart failure who have at least one eGFR value (LOINC 62238-1).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). The applicant has shown that anonymised data cannot achieve it, so pseudonymised data is justified (Art. 66(3)). Access only under a data permit (Art. 68) inside a secure processing environment; only non-personal data may leave it (Art. 73(2)).

judge.why: Rule 4: the access application explains that patients are followed over time with each patient's eGFR sequence linked to their own prescriptions, and the report asked for is only the cohort size.
